look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the earlier films of this series.

scenes.name: Dots or photos
scenes.desc: Dot colours are sparse and soft; the photos are sharp.

scenes.name: A texture for every mesh
scenes.desc: Each mesh is unfolded into a 4,096 by 4,096 texture; every texel is a spot on the skin.

scenes.name: First guess: the dots
scenes.desc: Each texel first takes a weighted mix of its 8 nearest dots.

scenes.name: Asking every photo
scenes.desc: A live 2D check: in front, facing, not hidden, inside the mask.

scenes.name: Picking the best photo
scenes.desc: Weights favour frontal, close views; sharpening lets the best one win.

scenes.name: Before and after
scenes.desc: Point bake against photo texture, front and back.

scenes.name: All eight methods
scenes.desc: The same texturing gives every method its colours.

scenes.name: In one line
scenes.desc: Photo texturing in one sentence, and what comes next.
